lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Array of discrete, high-luminance circular points organized into roughly equidistant horizontal rows across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid system on the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature with a high-intensity upper boundary and low-intensity lower shadow, defining a longitudinal carina along the upper third of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, low-luminance appendages/organisms positioned in the sub-pectoral region.
